page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block at top; woodcut engraving in the middle; below it a scripture citation, a motto in italic, a rule, and the imprint centred. Page number "2" at top right is handwritten and not transcribed.

main_text.l: Epistolam D. Pauli Apostoli ad Hebræos,
Aperi Domine Deus nobis ostium sermonis, ut loquamur mysterium Christi, & manifestemus illud, sicut oportet nos loqui.
Anno à Christo nato, M. D. LXXXIIII.

page.notes: The woodcut engraving (a decorative border with figures, putti and a central scene) is not transcribed as text. The long s is rendered as plain s; the printed "Ꝟt" in the motto is read as ut. The date line reads MDLXXXIIII as printed.
